messages:
olivia: FYI - EdgeHardware's marketplace adapter sent two different unit labels in the same hour ("token" and "tokens") and a couple of events with missing event_id. Our hourly rollup split them and entitlements showed as half usage for some customers. Need a partner fix + short-term normalization.

billing-bot: [ALERT] usage_schema_mismatch - partner=edgehardware mismatch_fields=[unit_type,event_id] first_seen=2026-03-21T09:12:08Z

john: Oof. Do we have sample payloads? If unit_type varies we either normalize to canonical unit in ingestion or reject. Which is preferable for marketplace partners?

kevin: For marketplace integrations we prefer strict schema validation at ingestion and a compatibility shim for a 48h grace window. That avoids silent miscounts. Proposed: accept variants but tag them as "normalized_unit":"tokens" and set "schema_fix_applied":true. Run a reconciliation for the last 24 hours.

lia: Partner comms: can we ask partners to adopt the canonical enum: ["tokens", "minutes", "requests"] and always include event_id (uuid-v4) and partner_version header. We should provide a small test harness.

john: Sample problematic payloads from EdgeHardware logs:
```json
{
  "account": "acct_91",
  "units": 4300,
  "unit_type": "token",
  "window_start": "2026-03-21T08:00:00Z",
  "window_end": "2026-03-21T09:00:00Z"
}
```
and
```json
{
  "account": "acct_91",
  "units": 4200,
  "unit_type": "tokens",
  "window_start": "2026-03-21T08:30:00Z",
  "window_end": "2026-03-21T09:30:00Z",
  "event_id": ""
}
```

kevin: Action plan (short):
- Ingestion change: map "token" -> "tokens" and require non-empty event_id. If event_id missing, mark event as "needs_partner_followup" and buffer in quarantine queue for 24h.
- Run reconciliation job for overlapping windows and produce delta report. Command: `./ops/reconcile --partner edgehardware --window 2026-03-21T07:00Z/2026-03-21T10:00Z --normalize unit_map.json --out deltas.csv`
- Send partner note with examples + test harness.

lia: I'll draft the partner note. Short template: "We detected inconsistent unit labels and missing event identifiers which caused split rollups for some customers. We've run a reconciliation and will apply adjustments where needed. Please update to the canonical unit enum and include an event_id UUID for every record. Test harness attached." Want to add anything about SLA or credits?

olivia: Add: we will auto-apply corrections for ingestion errors for 72h as a stopgap, after which messages without event_id will be rejected with 422. For any customer-facing charge impacts we'll coordinate credits via CS. Legal wants the CSV of affected accounts.

ops-bot: Reconciliation job queued - rq_id=rq_20260321_eh_07 submitted_by=kevin estimated_run=40m

billing-bot: Potential credit candidates detected - count=12 customers possibly overcharged delta_usd=34.50 sample_accounts=[acct_91,acct_112,acct_207]

john: I'll attach the deltas.csv to ticket PART-2387 and include a short reconciliation summary. Also adding an entry to the marketplace onboarding checklist: "unit_type must match Redwood canonical enum; event_id required; partner_version header optional but recommended."

kevin: I'll implement the ingestion normalization and a unit test matrix for variants. Also pushing a small companion script for partners: `scripts/validate-payload --file sample.json` that returns helpful errors. PR expected in ~1h.

lia: Draft partner email is ready; looping in EdgeHardware PM and FastSI integration lead. Will cc CS and legal.

olivia: Thanks. Once rq_id completes please drop the reconciliation summary and the affected-accounts CSV in the PART ticket. After we confirm adjustments, schedule a 30min sync with EdgeHardware to add the test harness to their CI.

kevin: rq_id=rq_20260321_eh_07 completed - summary_link=https://confluence.redwood/partnerships/edgehardware-recon-20260321 deltas.csv uploaded to PART-2387

lia: Partner looped in. EdgeHardware responded: they will ship a fix today and run our validate script.

olivia: Great work team. We'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
